---
name: Native review
about: Review a state or community you belong to
title: "Native review: <State or UT name>"
labels: ["needs-review"]
---

Thank you! You know this region better than any source. Please read `data/regions/<state>.json` (or the catalogue page once it exists) and tell us:

- **Wrong or outdated:** anything people there do not actually wear or do.
- **Missing:** communities, everyday clothes, festivals, settings we left out.
- **Stereotypes or disrespect:** anything that feels like a caricature, or an item with a meaning we got wrong (marital, religious, honour, mourning).
- **Do not depict:** any community or item that should not be shown at all.

You will be credited by your GitHub username or a pseudonym of your choice, never by your real name unless you ask. Please do not share personal details in this issue.
